respins.how_it_works:
The Zephyr Crest symbol activates when at least one Wild Spirit and one Zephyr Crest symbol appear on the grid at the same time. Once activated, the Zephyr Crest symbol expands all Spirit symbols on the grid, even if they are not part of a win. The Zephyr Crest symbol nudges all Wild Spirit symbols one reel to the left, awards a Respin, and applies a new Multiplier value to each Wild Spirit on the grid.

 Wild Spirits cannot be nudged off the grid. They will be nudged to the leftmost reel that is not already occupied by a Wild Spirit. Wild Spirits on the leftmost reel will remain in place and receive a new Multiplier during the Respin. New Spirits and Zephyr Crest symbols can land during the Respins, triggering more Wild Spirits and nudges. Only one Zephyr Crest symbol can land on the grid at a time.

wilds.name: EXPANDED WILD SPIRITS
wilds.behavior:
When a Spirit symbol lands, it expands into a Wild Spirit if the expanded symbol is a part of at least one winning combination once expanded.

 Spirit symbols only expand upward, to the top of the grid. Spirit symbols that land on the top row will still be counted as expanded Wild Spirits if part of a win. Expanded Wild Spirits count as Wilds on every position the expanded symbol covers. Only one Spirit symbol can land on a reel at a time.

 When a Wild Spirit expands it reveals a Multiplier which is applied to the entire Wild Spirit. If a winning combination includes more than one Multiplier, the Multiplier values will be added together and then applied to the win. Multipliers can have the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x

wilds.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - MIDNIGHT MAGIC
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This Hidden Epic Bonus keeps the mechanics of the WHISPERING WINDS bonus. In addition, each spin guarantees at least 2 Wild Spirits!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 FS and Zephyr Crest symbols cannot appear above Spirit symbols on the same reel.

modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the features of the SPIRITED SPINS bonus. In addition, above each reel is a Memory with multiplying values that start at 0x. Wild Spirit Multipliers are stored in the Memory throughout this bonus.

 When a Wild Spirit lands on a reel with a Memory value of 0x, it reveals a Multiplier that is applied to the win. This Multiplier is then stored in the Memory for the next spin.

 When a new Wild Spirit lands on a reel with a Memory value of 2x or higher, its Multiplier is revealed and combined with the stored Multiplier from the Memory to create a total Multiplier. This total Multiplier is then applied to all wins the reel is part of. Before the next spin, the total Multiplier is stored in the Memory on that reel. This process remains the same during Respins, with Wild Spirits receiving a new Multiplier when nudged.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.
